hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Partition the string into the smallest count of contiguous balanced segments where all unique letters appear with equal frequency.

hints.title: Balanced Substring Condition
hints.text: A substring is balanced if the frequencies of all present characters are equal.

hints.title: State Progression
hints.text: Define dp[i] as the minimum partitions for prefix of length i. For each previous index j, if substring from j to i is balanced, transition dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[j] + 1).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Quadratic dynamic programming with constant 26-character frequency comparisons.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive partitioning without memoization takes exponential O(2^n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use 1D prefix dynamic programming and check frequency equality across 26 characters.
